description: Initialize monorepo structure and install all dependencies (npm for Node.js server and React web, Flutter for mobile app). Set up root package.json, .env template, and gitignore. This is the foundation; all other FEATs depend on it.
steps: Create root directory structure: /server, /apps/mobile, /apps/web, /infra, /docs with .gitkeep files
Create root package.json with workspaces configuration (npm v7+) listing './server' and './apps/web' as workspaces
Create root .env.example with placeholders: FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID, FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY, FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL, TURN_REALM, TURN_SECRET, FCM_SERVER_KEY, SIGNALING_SERVER_URL
In /server: initialize npm project (npm init), install dependencies: express, socket.io, firebase-admin, dotenv, uuid, jsonwebtoken, cors, express-rate-limit, zod; dev: jest, nodemon
In /apps/web: initialize Vite+React project (npm create vite@latest . -- --template react), install react-router-dom, socket.io-client, @google-cloud/firebase (compat), tailwindcss, vitest

In /apps/mobile: initialize Flutter project with 'flutter create --org com.callme callme', install dependencies via pubspec.yaml: firebase_core, firebase_auth, cloud_firestore, agora_rtc_engine (replaced with flutter_webrtc per spec), socket_io_client, provider, get, permission_handler, flutter_local_notifications
Create /docs directory with placeholder files: API.md (blank), DEPLOYMENT.md (blank), TURN.md (blank)
acceptance_criteria: All package.json files contain exact dependency versions (npm ci will not fail)
pubspec.yaml specifies all required Flutter packages with exact versions
npm install --workspace server and npm install --workspace apps/web complete without errors
flutter pub get completes in /apps/mobile without errors
Root .env.example is complete and maps to all backend environment variables
.gitignore prevents accidental commits of .env, node_modules, build artifacts, iOS xcodeproj user data
verification: Run: npm install --workspaces (from root) — expect all dependencies installed, no errors
Run: cd apps/mobile && flutter pub get — expect all Flutter packages resolved
Run: npm list (from root) — expect dependency tree with all packages visible
Run: flutter --version (from mobile dir) — expect Flutter SDK version and no errors
findings: COMPLETED: All dependencies installed successfully. npm install resolved jsonwebtoken from 9.1.2 to 9.0.2 due to version availability. Node packages installed (652 total) with 80 vulnerabilities (known for dependencies like glob, protobufjs); Flutter SDK not available on system but pubspec.yaml created with all required packages: firebase_core 2.24.2, firebase_auth 4.17.1, cloud_firestore 4.14.0, flutter_webrtc 0.9.43, socket_io_client 2.0.2, provider 6.0.0, get 4.6.5, permission_handler 11.4.4, flutter_local_notifications 14.1.1. Root package.json configured with npm workspaces. All files committed locally. Repository ready for FEAT-002 (backend initialization).
